entries.title: Calendar save/load oracle re-ran randomized engine startup after loading
entries.first_observed: The second temperate seed in the first complete M21 exact-twin matrix failed the calendar save/load comparison.
entries.impact: A seed-dependent qualification failure could incorrectly classify correct restored engine state as divergent and prevented G21 acceptance.
entries.root_cause: The post-load comparison called StartupEngines again; that mutating initialization path can consume introduction randomness instead of reading the state restored from the save.

entries.title: M22 late-stage sampling and expanding retention accuracy rejected a valid campaign boundary
entries.first_observed: The first complete six-process M22 development campaign was rejected after specialist-router seed 1636894266 stopped producing checkpoints beyond update 16.
entries.impact: Independent weighted draws could underrepresent late programs, and a miss confined to a newly introduced program was mislabeled as catastrophic forgetting, preventing complete evidence retention and weakening broad-policy training coverage.
entries.root_cause: The rollout sampler had no per-program episode floor, while retention compared aggregate accuracy across expanding program denominators instead of checking whether a previously passing program was lost.

entries.title: M22 retained-runtime preparation omitted required staging and adapter preconditions
entries.first_observed: The first clean M22 retained-runtime attempt compiled but failed two graphics-dependent CTests; the next attempt passed CTest and staging but failed before its first smoke, and the non-accepting diagnostic then reached an unsupported G15 resource tier.
entries.impact: No invalid final-runtime record could be accepted, but the uncorrected preparer could not produce the complete native runtime required before independent evaluation.
entries.root_cause: The initial orchestration placed OpenGFX staging after CTest, did not create the shared smoke parent, and invented a final resource tier instead of projecting M15's accepted size-derived tier.

entries.title: M22 final adapter omitted two preregistered public probe aliases
entries.first_observed: The first clean final-runner invocation passed its fixed CUDA preflight, read the frozen manifest once, and rejected G15/m15-competence before creating the cases directory.
entries.impact: Zero final cases, final evaluator processes, or native dispatches ran, so no result could influence selection; however, the manifest was accessed and the source-generic adapter could not begin the preregistered suite.
entries.root_cause: The pre-access adapter tests covered the accepted G15 passenger-service and G16 single-leg harness names but not the manifest's public aliases m15-competence and industry-chain, both of which project to those same frozen native transactions.

entries.title: M22 final native harness projected invalid cargo, company, allocation, and map boundaries
entries.first_observed: Immutable final-v1 attempted all 42 cases once but eight native executions failed across passenger multimodal, 64-by-64 competition, authority/economy, and event recovery.
entries.impact: The learned policy and baseline statistics passed, but invalid harness/runtime boundaries prevented native every-mode, opponent, broad, and G15-G21 retention acceptance.
entries.root_cause: G19 forced freight truck stops for passenger multimodal service; G20 projected its frozen 128-by-128 eight-town floor onto sparse 64-by-64 worlds; G21 leaked competitor company context and directly allocated a disaster vehicle without checking pool capacity.

entries.title: M22 follow-up acceptance omitted routing-labeled multimodal service cases
entries.first_observed: The source-frozen independent follow-up-v1 suite completed all 42 cases with zero classified failures, but its aggregate status was FAIL because service_every_mode alone was false.
entries.impact: All learned actions, native cases, opponents, broad probes, and confidence requirements passed, yet G22 cannot accept the suite or relabel it after access because the frozen aggregate omitted multimodal from its service-mode set.
entries.root_cause: The acceptance function selected only cases whose task equals service; both positive multimodal-transfer cases are correctly task=routing, so their delivered cargo and income were never admitted into the service-mode coverage set.

diagnostics.review_note: The accepted M14-G21 implementation retains zero nonclosed defects or divergences. V2-DEF-0002 records and closes the M22 sampler and retention-classification failure found by the first complete matched development execution. V2-DEF-0003 records and closes the retained-runtime OpenGFX ordering, smoke-parent, and M15 tier-projection defects. V2-DEF-0004 records and closes the pre-case final-adapter failure. V2-DEF-0005 records and closes the four native harness/runtime boundary classes exposed by immutable final-v1: the corrected independent follow-up executed 42/42 native cases without a classified failure. V2-DEF-0006 remains diagnosed and release-blocking because follow-up-v1's frozen acceptance function omitted its two routing-labeled, positive-service multimodal cases; the complete zero-failure result remains FAIL and will not be relabeled or rerun. ChooChoo, SimpleAI, and malformed Lufthansa packages retain their truthful rejection dispositions; ShipAI's M14 healthy-inactive result remains supplemented by M18 scenario-specific active evidence. G20 publishes external-AI choices as stochastic replicates, and G21 deliberately claims only the finite ten-package NewGRF compatibility set.
